sections.title: Brand at a Glance
sections.content: Thoughtseed is a founder-led systems studio. Headline: Digital Wilderness. Tagline: We plant ideas. They grow wild. Promise: One coherent system from requirement to handoff. CTA: Bring the requirement.

sections.title: Mission & Values
sections.content: Mission: Thoughtseed turns complex requirements into coherent systems by aligning user psychology, founder operating logic, interface design, engineering delivery, and structured handoff — inside one delivery loop. Values: coherence over performative specialization, ownership over dependency, competence and taste with restraint, evidence of shipping over polished promises, clarity about tradeoffs.

sections.title: Brand Personality
sections.content: Archetype: Sage + Creator. Adjectives: clear, grounded, crafted, founder-led, precise. If-a-person: founder-side systems translator. Speaking as an operator who has built systems and lived with ambiguity. Peer to the founder. Short declarative sentences with evidence close to the claim.

sections.title: Voice & Tone
sections.content: Voice matrix: formality 0.55, enthusiasm 0.4, technicality 0.6, warmth 0.5, authority 0.7. Tone variations: announcement (calm confidence, state what shipped), support (steady, exact, point to next step), education (explicit, structured, low-drama), crisis (serious, grounded, evidence-close), sales (confident, concrete, scoped not pressured). Channel calibration: website hero (spare, atmospheric), proposal (named requirement first), technical docs (low-drama, inheritable), case study (evidence-led), founder note (peer-to-peer).

sections.title: Visual Identity
sections.content: Visual concept: Digital Wilderness — disciplined engineering meets organic emergence. Architectural precision against cultivated texture. Materials: matte paper, brushed aluminum, weathered stone, living moss, oxidized copper, screen glow, architectural shadow. Photography: editorial-documentary, real prototyping spaces. Logo: horizontal wordmark + tree mark (canonical, never regenerated). Logo objects: dark metal emblem, metallic 3D, glass, wax seal, holo-vinyl, concrete-botanical installation — art-direction references, never replacement marks.

sections.title: Messaging
sections.content: Key messages: Digital Wilderness, We plant ideas. They grow wild., Bring the requirement., Founder-led systems studio, One coherent system from requirement to handoff. Value pillars: One integrated delivery loop, Founder-led judgment, Ownership transfer as first-class output, Studio-plus-IP model. Observable outcome: 'Your team runs and extends the system without us after handoff — fewer vendors, owned delivery.'

sections.title: Positioning
sections.content: Differentiation: One integrated studio logic (vs fragmented vendors), Founder-led judgment (vs account-managed), Handoff as first-class output (vs closing footnote), Studio-plus-IP (vs pure services). Points of parity: senior design and engineering craft, modern engineering across web/mobile/AI, project framing, professional artifacts. Observable outcome: the team runs and extends the system without us after handoff. Wedge vs integrated boutique product studios (Thoughtbot, Work&Co, Metalab, Postlight): founder-led + requirement-to-handoff ownership + studio-plus-IP, not just one team.

sections.title: Audience
sections.content: Primary: Mira, the System-Carrying Founder. Founder / CTO / innovation lead / product strategist. Lean senior team. Funded startups through scaleups. Pain points: fragmentation across vendors, strategy disconnected from shipped reality, shallow AI proposals, handoff breaks. Goals: solve without becoming translator, one studio that understands, system they can run. Secondary: innovation team / technical operator needing one coherent partner.

sections.title: What We Don't Do
sections.content: Prohibited terms (never use in public copy): consciousness-aligned, conscious growth, consciousness technology, organic growth operations, disruptive, revolutionary, synergy, best-in-class, future-proof, cutting-edge, guru, healing journey, vibration, AMC, full-service agency. Forbidden visual elements: purple SaaS gradients, stock startup photos, empty futurism, mystical fog, glossy plastic, cartoon icons, baked-in text.
